targets.old_statement: A fluorescent or reflective orange and red triangle on the back of a farm, construction or animal-drawn vehicle means it travels at less than 25 mph, so approach with care and pass only when it is safe.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A fluorescent or reflective orange and red triangle on the back of a farm, construction or animal-drawn vehicle means it travels at less than twenty-five miles per hour, so approach with care and pass only when it is safe.
